sign_in.title: Sign in to Eldes Gate
sign_in.description:
Use the same credentials you use in the official Eldes Gates mobile app.

The Eldes API only accepts one device UUID per account at a time. Leaving "Device UUID" blank mints a fresh one — adding HA will sign the phone app out the next time it logs in. To keep the phone working alongside HA, paste the phone's UUID into this field (see the integration README for how to extract `vendorid` from the app's SharedPreferences).

init.description: The phone on the sign-in screen is only the account username. It is not sent in the open command.

controller_sim.title: Choose a controller
controller_sim.description: Each controller has its own SIM number. This is not the account username.

controller_sim_edit.title: Controller SIM number (experimental)
controller_sim_edit.description:
This value is the controller SIM placed after the semicolon in the existing open command. It is not the account username.

Device-list phone field: {api_phone_state}. Saved override active: {override_active}.

Submit an empty field, or enable removal, to delete the saved number and use the device-list phone again. If that list field is missing or empty, the command keeps a blank phone, which is the current behavior. Saving a number is experimental and does not guarantee the gate will move. Removal wins if both the checkbox and a new number are set.
